data.gender_notes: Kallappa is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who serves Lord Shiva, the God of destruction. In Hindu mythology, Kallappa is a divine being and servant of Lord Shiva. He is often depicted as a powerful warrior or elephant-headed god, symbolizing strength and devotion. The name Kallappa carries the meaning “Lord Shiva's servant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kallappa usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes dedication and service to the divine.
data.etymology: Kallappa belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Shiva's servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kallappa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kallappa holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism, as it is associated with those who are devoted to Lord Shiva, one of the primary gods in the Hindu pantheon. Kallappa is a name that signifies strong religious beliefs and a deep connection to the Hindu faith. It is a name that reminds us of the rich history and cultural heritage of Hinduism, and the important role that deities and spiritual practices play in the lives of its followers.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Kallappa signifies servitude and devotion to the divine. It is a reminder of our duty to serve and connect with the higher power, and to seek guidance and protection from the gods. The name also symbolizes strength and courage, as Lord Shiva is often depicted as a powerful and fearsome god. By carrying the name Kallappa, one may be reminded to embody these qualities and to strive for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Kallappa: The name Kallappa is derived from the Tamil words 'Kallan' meaning 'servant' and 'Appan' meaning 'father'. This name symbolizes a devoted son or servant, who is deeply committed to serving and pleasing his father or spiritual guide. It signifies selflessness, dedication, and loyalty in one's spiritual or familial journey.
